name: std::mdspan<T,Extents,LayoutPolicy,AccessorPolicy>::extent

declarations.code: constexpr index_type extent(rank_type r) const noexcept;

intro: Returns the extent of a mdspan at the rank index r. Equivalent to return extents().extent(r);.

r

 -
